blocked.description: Waiting on a dependency or external input.

subtasks.title: Port event-bus.ts → event_bus.zig
subtasks.context: Upstream packages/coding-agent/src/core/event-bus.ts (33 LoC) provides a typed pub/sub bus used by every emitted lifecycle event. pi-zig has NO equivalent module.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: New src/pi/event_bus.zig with subscribe/publish + per-event handler lists; unit tests cover ordering, multiple subscribers, removal mid-dispatch; wired into agent.zig + rpc.zig.

subtasks.title: Port telemetry.ts → telemetry.zig
subtasks.context: Upstream telemetry.ts (13 LoC) exports a minimal telemetry sink interface that other modules call. pi-zig has no equivalent.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/telemetry.zig with structured event emission; optional OTLP forwarding path stubbed cleanly (skip without endpoint); unit tests.

subtasks.title: Port timings.ts → timings.zig
subtasks.context: Upstream timings.ts (31 LoC) records spans + durations for prompt/turn/tool execution. pi-zig has no equivalent.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/timings.zig with start/stop span API; emitted into event_bus; unit tests cover nested spans.

subtasks.title: Port exec.ts → exec.zig
subtasks.context: Upstream exec.ts (107 LoC) is the cross-platform process exec helper used by tools and the agent harness. pi-zig calls std.process.run directly in scattered sites.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/exec.zig with consolidated exec API (env, cwd, stdin, timeout, signal); callers refactored where it removes duplication.

subtasks.title: Full FooterDataProvider (watcher + worktrees + reftable + extension statuses + provider badge)
subtasks.context: Upstream footer-data-provider.ts (354 LoC) feeds the live footer: git branch with reftable + worktree awareness, watched extension health badges, provider/model + thinking-level + token usage + cost. pi-zig's current `resolveGitBranch` (tui.zig) is a one-shot stub that runs `git symbolic-ref` once.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/footer_data.zig that exposes a FooterData struct mirroring upstream's fields; fs.watch on .git/HEAD + worktrees + extension manifests; subscriber API for tui_footer.zig; unit tests + smoke driving a real worktree switch.

subtasks.title: Wire all missing AgentSessionEvent dispatches
subtasks.context: Upstream emits 29+ AgentSessionEvents; pi-zig advertises them in upstream.zig but DOES NOT actually dispatch ~17 of them (session_before_compact, session_compact, session_before_tree, session_tree, session_before_fork, session_before_switch, queue_update, compaction_start/end, session_info_changed, thinking_level_changed, model_select, thinking_level_select, message_update, tool_execution_*, before_agent_start, resources_discover, context, input).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each missing event has a concrete dispatch site in rpc.zig/agent.zig with the upstream payload shape; extensions receive them via the existing FLOW_J seam; per-event smoke proves the extension handler observes the event.
requirements: No fire-and-forget where upstream chains values (must honor returned transforms)

subtasks.title: importFromJsonl / exportToJsonl / reload
subtasks.context: Upstream session-manager exposes importFromJsonl, exportToJsonl, reload(); none exist in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/session.zig gains the three functions with byte-exact JSONL round-trip; unit tests cover empty/malformed/header-only sessions.

subtasks.title: createAgentSessionServices / FromServices / Runtime factory pattern
subtasks.context: Upstream uses a 3-layer factory: createAgentSessionServices (wire services), createAgentSessionFromServices (compose), createAgentSessionRuntime (drive). pi-zig builds Runtime once at process start; cannot tear down and rebuild mid-process.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Refactor agent.zig + rpc.zig so a Runtime can be (re)constructed from a Services struct; in-process swap supported; unit test exercises two sequential lifetimes.

subtasks.title: getAttributionHeaders (OpenRouter / Cloudflare / opencode)
subtasks.context: Upstream attaches HTTP attribution headers (HTTP-Referer, X-Title, opencode session id) on provider requests. pi-zig sends none.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: ai_client.zig adds attribution-header construction gated by provider id; smoke asserts headers on outgoing requests.

subtasks.title: excludeFromContext (!! prefix), scoped-models cycling, setRebindSession, withSession, nextTurn custom messages, before_agent_start system-prompt override, dynamic image filtering
subtasks.context: Cluster of session-control features missing entirely. excludeFromContext lets a user message with `!!` prefix run a bash without entering the LLM context; scoped-models cycles a curated subset; setRebindSession swaps the bound session; withSession() wraps a callback in a session; before_agent_start hook can replace the system prompt per turn; blockImages dynamically strips images from outgoing messages.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each sub-feature has a code path + unit test + integration smoke; documented in docs/parity.md per-feature row.

subtasks.title: AuthStorage class abstraction + runtime --api-key override + models.json fallback
subtasks.context: Upstream AuthStorage class exposes get/set/list with runtime --api-key override and models.json fallback for custom providers. pi-zig's auth.zig has flat function helpers and only 3 of 6 upstream source arms in status output; no runtime --api-key override.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/auth_storage.zig with full AuthStorage API + `--api-key` override + models.json fallback resolver; status output covers all 6 source arms; unit tests for each source.

subtasks.title: Interactive OAuth login: PKCE + device-code + local callback HTTP server
subtasks.context: pi-zig's interactive login (auth.zig:1431-1447) always returns InteractiveLoginUnavailable. Upstream supports PKCE for Anthropic, device-code for OpenAI Codex + GitHub Copilot, local callback HTTP server, manual-paste fallback.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/auth_login.zig with PKCE generator, callback server, device-code polling for each of the 3 OAuth providers; live-cred opt-in smokes (skip cleanly without creds); never print secrets.

subtasks.title: Cross-process file lock for auth.json + chmod 0o600
subtasks.context: Concurrent pi-zig instances can clobber freshly minted OAuth tokens. Upstream uses flock. pi-zig has none. File mode is default (group-readable on most setups).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: auth.json reads/writes wrapped in OS-appropriate advisory lock; chmod 0o600 on write; unit test triggers two concurrent writes and verifies last-writer-wins atomic.

subtasks.title: configureHttpDispatcher with runtime httpIdleTimeoutMs effect
subtasks.context: pi-zig parses httpIdleTimeoutMs from settings and shows it but it has ZERO runtime effect on actual HTTP traffic. Upstream's http-dispatcher applies it.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/http_dispatcher.zig that wraps std.http.Client with idle-timeout enforcement; setting changes propagate live; smoke proves a slow server times out at the configured value.

subtasks.title: session-cwd.ts: persist cwd into session header, missing-cwd check
subtasks.context: Upstream session-cwd.ts persists project cwd into the session JSONL header and exposes a missing-cwd check. pi-zig writes `"cwd":"."` (hardcoded) so the precondition is destroyed.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Session header carries the real absolute cwd; missing-cwd check refuses to load when target cwd is gone; unit + smoke.

subtasks.title: output-guard.ts: stdout takeover + ENOBUFS-retry backpressure pump
subtasks.context: Upstream output-guard.ts owns the stdout takeover for JSON/RPC modes and applies ENOBUFS-retry backpressure on writes. pi-zig has no such layer.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/output_guard.zig with write pump + ENOBUFS retry + flush guarantees; rpc.zig and JSON mode routed through it; unit test with a fake non-blocking pipe.

subtasks.title: auth-guidance.ts: 4 shared formatter functions
subtasks.context: Upstream auth-guidance.ts exports 4 shared formatter functions used in CLI error messages. Absent in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Helper functions ported with byte-exact strings; reused from auth + cli_runtime error paths; unit tests pin the exact strings.

subtasks.title: diagnostics.ts schemas: ResourceCollision + ResourceDiagnostic
subtasks.context: Upstream diagnostics.ts defines two TypeBox schemas (ResourceCollision, ResourceDiagnostic) consumed by commands/themes. pi-zig emits a similar JSON but has no type/schema.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/diagnostics.zig with the two structs + JSON serialization; commands.zig and themes.zig use them.

subtasks.title: resolveConfigValue cache + resolveHeaders helper
subtasks.context: Upstream caches `!cmd` shell-resolved values; pi-zig re-runs the shell exec on every call. Upstream has a separate resolveHeaders that expands `!cmd` per-header.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: auth.zig adds a cache (TTL configurable) + resolveHeaders helper; unit test ensures cache hit on repeated read.

subtasks.title: Settings write-path per-field validation + clamping
subtasks.context: Settings READ-path validates but WRITE-path doesn't. Bad values land in settings.json silently.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each write path validates + clamps per upstream rules; bad input rejected with diagnostic; unit tests per field.

subtasks.title: Compaction: findCutPoint + keepRecentTokens + split-turn
subtasks.context: Upstream compaction preserves a "recent window" and can split a turn boundary. pi-zig compacts the entire ring (no recent window) and never splits a turn.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/compaction.zig with findCutPoint / keepRecentTokens / split-turn helpers; rpc.zig FLOW_E uses them; unit tests cover token-budget edge cases.

subtasks.title: UPDATE_SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT + TURN_PREFIX_SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT
subtasks.context: Two summarization prompt constants used when re-summarizing on top of an existing compaction or prefixing a turn. Absent in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Constants ported byte-exact; used by FLOW_E compaction code path.

subtasks.title: estimateContextTokens from Usage
subtasks.context: pi-zig estimates tokens by chars/4. Upstream uses provider-reported Usage. Requires Usage in ChatCompletionResult.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: ChatCompletionResult carries Usage; compaction trigger reads it; unit tests check overflow trigger fires when usage exceeds budget.

subtasks.title: Fix firstKeptEntryId semantic (currently OPPOSITE of upstream)
subtasks.context: pi-zig sets firstKeptEntryId = messages[0].entryId() — the FIRST message. Upstream sets it to the first KEPT message after compaction (typically the last one before the cut). Reload misbehaves.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Semantic corrected; reload tests pass; round-trip exercises pre/post-compaction state.

subtasks.title: parseStoredRole / loadSessionEntries: recognize branchSummary
subtasks.context: Upstream stores branch_summary as a role-tagged entry; on reload pi-zig's parseStoredRole DOES NOT recognize the branchSummary role, so branch_summary entries don't re-inject into in-memory context.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: parseStoredRole supports branchSummary; loadSessionEntries loads them; re-injects on reload; round-trip test.

subtasks.title: BRANCH_SUMMARY_PREFIX/SUFFIX constants + BranchSummaryDetails {readFiles, modifiedFiles, replaceInstructions, BRANCH_SUMMARY_PREAMBLE}
subtasks.context: Upstream wraps branch_summary entries in PREFIX/SUFFIX and carries file-ops details. Absent in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Constants + struct ported; FLOW_G writes them; unit tests assert the on-disk JSONL shape.

subtasks.title: Wire remaining 9 of 21 builtin slash commands
subtasks.context: tui.zig:runCommand reports "recognized but not yet wired" for ~9 of 21 slash commands. The user demanded no stubs.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each remaining command is fully implemented (real handler, not "not yet wired"); per-command App-level unit test; smoke proves CLI-observable behavior where applicable.
requirements: No "not yet wired" lines remain in tui.zig

subtasks.title: KeybindingsManager: 43 ids + keybindings.json loader + KEYBINDING_NAME_MIGRATIONS + Windows special cases
subtasks.context: pi-zig covers ~12 of 43 upstream AppKeybindings ids; no keybindings.json loader, no migrations, no Windows differences.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/keybindings.zig (new) with full id list + JSON loader + migrations table + Windows variants; unit tests per id.

subtasks.title: SessionManager: list / listAll / inMemory / continueRecent / createBranchedSession
subtasks.context: Upstream surfaces 5 session-level operations missing in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each function ported; unit tests + smoke; CLI `--resume` picker (D6) consumes list output.

subtasks.title: LabelEntry: appendLabelChange + getLabel
subtasks.context: Upstream session JSONL supports LabelEntry rows; pi-zig has no such entry type.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: session.zig writes/reads LabelEntry; appendLabelChange/getLabel; round-trip test.

subtasks.title: Fix hardcoded session-header cwd="." and timestamp="local-foundation"
subtasks.context: session.zig:108 writes `"cwd":"."`; timestamp is a placeholder string. Upstream writes the real absolute cwd + ISO timestamp.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Real cwd + ISO timestamp; backward-load is tolerant of legacy values; smoke verifies fresh session header.

subtasks.title: Multi-version session loading (v1→v2, v2→v3 migrations)
subtasks.context: pi-zig rejects any session whose header is not version:3. Upstream migrates v1→v2 and v2→v3 on load.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Migration functions ported; reload of legacy session works; round-trip test per migration.

subtasks.title: excludeFromContext (!! prefix) modeled in messages
subtasks.context: A user message starting with `!!` runs a bash but is NOT entered into the LLM context. Not modeled in pi-zig's messages.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Message type carries excludeFromContext flag; provider history skips them; smoke shows the bash ran and the assistant didn't see the message.

subtasks.title: CustomMessage.details + image-block content persisted
subtasks.context: CustomMessage.details (free-form JSON) and image-block content are NOT persisted by pi-zig's appendCustomMessage.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: JSONL carries details + image parts; reload restores them; unit test round-trip.

subtasks.title: Source-info: SourceScope / SourceOrigin / SourceInfo + createSourceInfo / createSyntheticSourceInfo
subtasks.context: Upstream models source-info as 3 typed scopes + factory functions. pi-zig only serializes JSON via writeSourceInfoWithOrigin; no types/factories.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/source_info.zig with the 3 types + factory functions; commands.zig consumes them; unit tests.

subtasks.title: Migrations: 5 missing (auth-to-json, sessions-from-agent-root, commands-to-prompts, tools-to-bin, keybindings-config-file)
subtasks.context: Upstream migrations.ts runs 5 one-shot migrations on first launch. pi-zig has 0% of this.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/migrations.zig with all 5 migrations; idempotent; runs on cli_runtime entrypoint; unit tests verify each migration's before/after on a temp dir.

subtasks.title: RpcClient programmatic API
subtasks.context: Upstream exports an RpcClient class for embedders (Node/TS callers). pi-zig has no equivalent — consumers must speak JSONL directly.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/rpc_client.zig (Zig embedder API) + a frontend client wrapper if needed; smoke drives it.

subtasks.title: utils/ closures: clipboard, image-resize, syntax-highlight, version-check, tools-manager, Windows self-update quarantine, changelog parser
subtasks.context: pi-zig's utils coverage is ~30%; 7 specific helpers missing.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each helper has a Zig port (or honest shell-out for image-resize); per-helper unit test.

subtasks.title: cli/ closures: selectConfig, selectSession, listModels text rendering, image-resize processFileArguments
subtasks.context: pi-zig's cli/ coverage is ~40%.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each function ported; smoke verifies CLI-observable text output.

subtasks.title: `pi config` TUI
subtasks.context: Upstream `pi config` opens a TUI for resource enable/disable. pi-zig has no such command.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: New subcommand `pi-zig config` opens a TUI dialog (via tui_selector) to toggle resources; persisted to settings.

subtasks.title: `--resume` session picker UI
subtasks.context: pi-zig opens the newest session directly. Upstream offers a picker UI.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: TUI picker built on tui_selector; smoke drives selection by index.

subtasks.title: `--session` cross-project global prompt
subtasks.context: Upstream supports a cross-project session prompt. pi-zig is project-local.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: --session can target any cwd; safety: refuse if cwd missing; unit test.

subtasks.title: `--api-key` without `--model` diagnostic
subtasks.context: Upstream emits a specific error when --api-key is supplied without --model. pi-zig silently ignores.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Exact upstream diagnostic emitted; unit test pins the string.

subtasks.title: `queue_update` RPC event
subtasks.context: Upstream emits queue_update events whenever steering/follow-up queue changes. pi-zig requires clients to poll.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: rpc.zig emits queue_update on every change; smoke asserts events flow.

subtasks.title: Multi-message print mode (loop)
subtasks.context: Upstream `for (const message of messages) await session.prompt(message)`; pi-zig folds multiple messages into one.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Print-mode loops per-message; smoke proves N messages produce N assistant turns.

subtasks.title: `--list-models` text rendering
subtasks.context: pi-zig emits JSON only; upstream has a tabular text mode (default).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Default text rendering; --json keeps JSON output; unit test.

subtasks.title: Wire orphan tui_markdown / tui_footer / tui_messages / tui_theme / tui_selector into tui.zig + index.zig
subtasks.context: These modules exist with passing unit tests but are NOT imported by tui.zig and NOT exported from src/pi/index.zig — dead code. The live binary never paints them.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui.zig:buildScreen routes user/assistant/tool/bash entries through tui_messages; transcript text routes through tui_markdown; bottom strip uses tui_footer; theme palette derived via tui_theme; overlay selectors use tui_selector; pty harness + browser screenshots show the live difference.
requirements: Each integration has at least one smoke assertion that the new render reaches stdout

subtasks.title: Port 24 missing interactive components
subtasks.context: 24 of 35 upstream components have NO equivalent: login-dialog, oauth-selector, session-selector, session-selector-search, tree-selector, settings-selector, scoped-models-selector, extension-editor, extension-input, extension-selector, config-selector, custom-editor, theme-selector, thinking-selector, show-images-selector, user-message-selector, dynamic-border, bordered-loader, custom-message, branch-summary-message, compaction-summary-message, skill-invocation-message, tool-execution, image.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each component has a Zig module + unit tests + integration smoke proving live render.
requirements: Box-drawing matches upstream square corners (not arc)

subtasks.title: Theme: full 49-token palette, truecolor, file watcher, COLORFGBG/OSC 11 detection, theme reload, markdown/syntax themes, /theme builtin
subtasks.context: pi-zig consumes 6 of 49 upstream theme tokens; no truecolor; no watcher; no COLORFGBG/OSC 11 detection; /theme not even in builtin_commands.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui_theme.zig consumes all 49 tokens, truecolor support, file watcher reloads, COLORFGBG/OSC 11 read at startup, /theme command opens a theme selector; per-token unit tests.

subtasks.title: InteractiveMode controller: port remaining ~125 of 150 methods
subtasks.context: Upstream's InteractiveMode (5564 LoC) has ~150 methods. pi-zig has ≤25. Missing entire subsystems: extension UI, message queueing/steering/follow-up, double-key timing, compaction/retry state, event-driven handleEvent (15-arm switch).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each missing subsystem ported with App-level unit tests + integration smoke; documented per-method coverage.

subtasks.title: Animated spinner (replace static "[working...]")
subtasks.context: pi-zig shows "[working... press Esc to abort]" static. Upstream animates a spinner.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Spinner cycles per render; smoke captures multiple frames.

subtasks.title: Terminal-width dynamic dividers
subtasks.context: Dividers are hardcoded 80 cells. Upstream scales to terminal width.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Read columns via TIOCGWINSZ; divider auto-fits; SIGWINCH triggers reflow.

subtasks.title: OSC 133 zone codes + OSC 9;4 progress
subtasks.context: Modern terminals (iTerm2, WezTerm, kitty) honor OSC 133 (semantic prompt zones) and OSC 9;4 (progress bar). Both absent.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Emit OSC 133 around prompt/output zones; OSC 9;4 progress around active tool runs; smoke captures escape sequences in stdout.

subtasks.title: Earendil-announcement / armin / daxnuts easter eggs
subtasks.context: Three small visual easter-eggs present upstream; absent in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each rendered when triggered; smoke proves activation paths.

subtasks.title: Switch box-drawing arc corners ╭╮╰╯ → square ┌┐└┘ (or expose as theme)
subtasks.context: pi-zig uses arc corners; upstream uses square. Visual divergence.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Default is square (matching upstream); theme can override.
requirements: No regression in unit tests asserting specific glyphs

subtasks.title: Update Available banner with real version-check HTTP probe
subtasks.context: Currently gated on PI_ZIG_NEW_VERSION env; no real version check.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Background HTTP probe of pi.dev/api/latest-version (configurable); banner shows when newer is available; cached for N hours.

subtasks.title: Embeddable Agent / AgentHarness classes
subtasks.context: Upstream exports Agent + AgentHarness classes for library consumers. pi-zig's code is process-coupled.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/agent_harness.zig provides a stable embedder API; sample embedder demo; unit tests.

subtasks.title: Pluggable StreamFn
subtasks.context: Provider is hardcoded in ai_client.zig. Upstream allows a StreamFn override.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: agent.zig accepts a stream callback; existing providers wrap it; unit test with a fake StreamFn.

subtasks.title: Parallel tool execution + executionMode
subtasks.context: Upstream supports parallel tool execution per-turn. pi-zig is sequential.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: agent.zig executes independent tool calls in parallel when executionMode=parallel; per-tool isolation; unit test counts wall-clock vs serial.

subtasks.title: transformContext / convertToLlm callbacks
subtasks.context: Upstream hooks to transform context + convert to LLM format. pi-zig has no such seam.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Hooks added to RunOptions; unit tests cover transform + convert.

subtasks.title: ExecutionEnv abstraction
subtasks.context: Upstream tools call through an ExecutionEnv; pi-zig calls std.fs / std.process directly. Hard to mock.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: ExecutionEnv interface added; tools refactored to call it; mock-env tests.

subtasks.title: Result<T,E> model + stable error-code classes
subtasks.context: Upstream uses a Result pattern with classified errors; pi-zig uses Zig error union with coarse names.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Wrap public APIs in Result-equivalent; map upstream error codes 1:1; consumer-friendly.

subtasks.title: streamProxy
subtasks.context: Upstream's streamProxy multiplexes provider streams; absent in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: streamProxy ported; smoke proves dual-consumer scenario.

subtasks.title: In-memory session backend
subtasks.context: Upstream supports an in-memory session backend for tests/ephemeral runs.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/session_repo.zig with an InMemory backend selectable via RunOptions; unit test exercises both backends.

subtasks.title: JsonlSessionRepo class + cwd-indexed dirs + encodeCwd
subtasks.context: Upstream organizes session JSONLs in cwd-indexed dirs via encodeCwd helper. pi-zig uses a single sessions dir.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: JsonlSessionRepo with cwd-encoded subdirs; encodeCwd helper byte-exact; smoke verifies dir layout.

subtasks.title: UUID v7
subtasks.context: Upstream uses UUID v7 for run ids; pi-zig uses ad-hoc ids.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/uuid.zig with v7 generator; unit tests verify time-ordered uniqueness.

subtasks.title: Outer follow-up replay (single agent loop drains batches)
subtasks.context: RPC currently re-invokes runPrompt per drained batch. Upstream's agent loop drains internally.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: agent.zig loops over queue; rpc.zig dispatches once; unit test exercises multi-batch drain.

subtasks.title: prepareNextTurn: replace context/messages/tools/thinkingLevel
subtasks.context: pi-zig can swap only system_prompt/provider/model/api_key. Upstream's hook can replace context/messages/tools/thinkingLevel.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Hook signature extended; unit tests cover each replacement field.

subtasks.title: Tool hook fields: signal / args(validated) / context / details
subtasks.context: Before/after tool hooks miss the upstream-shaped fields (validated args, cancellation signal, ambient context, run details).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Hook signature extended; each field test-asserted; extensions can read all four.

subtasks.title: agentLoopContinue + listener-signal propagation
subtasks.context: Upstream's agentLoopContinue lets a hook abort or chain; signal propagates to listeners.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Function + signal wired; unit test triggers continue/abort from a hook.

subtasks.title: File-ops tracking (readFiles / modifiedFiles summary blocks)
subtasks.context: Tool runs that touch files surface readFiles/modifiedFiles in turn summaries upstream; absent in pi-zig.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tools.zig records file ops; agent.zig surfaces them in turn summary; smoke shows the lists.

subtasks.title: BUG: bash full-output path collides on concurrent runs
subtasks.context: tools.zig writes shell full-output to fixed zig-out/pi-zig-bash-full-output.log. Two concurrent bash tools clobber each other.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Per-run temp file via ExecutionEnv.createTempFile; concurrent-run test passes.

subtasks.title: getEntriesToFork "at" mode
subtasks.context: Upstream supports forking AT a specific entry; pi-zig's fork is "from leaf" only.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: API supports both modes; smoke proves each.

subtasks.title: Codex Responses transport (entirely missing)
subtasks.context: Catalog lists openai-codex-responses models; dispatcher routes them through chat/completions — INCOMPATIBLE shape. No SSE, no responses_websockets=2026-02-06, no chatgpt-account-id header, no retry-after-ms, no plan-aware errors, no session connection cache, no previous_response_id delta-context.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: ai_client.zig dispatches openai-codex-responses to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses with SSE + all required headers + retry-after parsing + previous_response_id chaining; smoke proves end-to-end.

subtasks.title: detectCompat 14-field per-provider compat (20+ providers)
subtasks.context: pi-zig sends one fixed shape with tool_choice:"auto". Upstream's detectCompat (line 1070, openai-completions.ts) has 14 fields covering 20+ providers (Cerebras, x.ai, Together, chutes.ai, DeepSeek, z.ai, Moonshot, Cloudflare Workers AI/AI Gateway, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Anthropic-via-OpenRouter).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: detectCompat ported with all 14 fields + 20+ providers; smoke tests per provider hit a fake server with the right shape.

subtasks.title: Interactive OAuth login (PKCE + callback + device-code)
subtasks.context: Refresh works for all 3 providers; login requires manual `auth set-oauth <…>`. No PKCE, no callback server, no device-code, no manual-paste race.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: `pi-zig auth login <provider>` runs the full PKCE/device-code flow; live cred opt-in; never prints secrets; fake-endpoint smoke.

subtasks.title: Anthropic Messages depth: cache_control / thinking / OAuth tool-name remap / eager_input_streaming / redacted_thinking / x-session-affinity / dynamic max_tokens
subtasks.context: pi-zig's Anthropic transport is shallow: max_tokens hardcoded 4096; no cache_control ephemeral blocks; no thinking/output_config.effort; no OAuth tool-name remap (16 canonical names); no eager_input_streaming; no redacted_thinking round-trip; no aborted-thinking-signature downgrade; no x-session-affinity.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each feature wired with smoke + unit; OAuth tool-name remap table byte-exact.

subtasks.title: Bedrock depth: cache points / reasoningContent.signature / additionalModelRequestFields / requestMetadata / GovCloud strip / exception-name map / ~/.aws/credentials profile / IMDS chain
subtasks.context: SigV4 signer verified vs AWS get-vanilla; missing all the cache and reasoning features.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each feature ported with unit test; profile + IMDS chain end-to-end smoke.

subtasks.title: Missing helpers: transform-messages.ts / cloudflare.ts / github-copilot-headers.ts / openai-prompt-cache.ts / simple-options.ts (reasoning plumbing)
subtasks.context: Several cross-provider helpers absent; their consumers degrade silently.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each helper ported with unit tests + consumed by providers that need it.

subtasks.title: Wire 15+ unwired OpenAI-compatible providers in endpointForProvider
subtasks.context: Only 7 providers wired in endpointForProvider; 15+ in the catalog have no endpoint mapping → 404 on use.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each catalog provider has a mapped endpoint; smoke per provider against a fake server.

subtasks.title: Usage tracking in ChatCompletionResult + calculateCost
subtasks.context: No Usage struct anywhere; no per-token cost calculation. Compaction triggers can't use real tokens; footer can't show cost.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: ChatCompletionResult carries Usage {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cache_read, cache_write}; calculateCost computes from model costs; unit tests cover each provider's usage parse.

subtasks.title: api-registry: provider registration + custom-provider extension API landing
subtasks.context: Provider dispatch is a hardcoded switch in streamChatTurnData. Extension API pi.registerProvider has nowhere to land.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/api_registry.zig with a registry; built-in providers register at startup; extensions can dynamically register; smoke proves a custom-provider extension dispatches.

subtasks.title: AssistantMessageEventStream + 13-arm typed event union
subtasks.context: pi-zig uses scattered callbacks. Upstream has a typed 13-arm event union streamed during a turn.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/assistant_event_stream.zig with the union; agent.zig emits via it; CLI/RPC consumers re-emit.

subtasks.title: utils/json-parse.ts: repair + streaming-JSON tolerance
subtasks.context: Provider responses occasionally have malformed JSON or interleaved control sequences. Upstream repairs; pi-zig errors out.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/json_parse.zig with repair + partial-token tolerance; unit tests cover common malformations.
requirements: No false repairs of structurally bad input

subtasks.title: utils/node-http-proxy.ts: HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / no_proxy
subtasks.context: pi-zig ignores all proxy env vars.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/http_proxy.zig parses env, wires std.http.Client proxy; smoke verifies routing through a fake proxy.

subtasks.title: utils/sanitize-unicode.ts, diagnostics.ts, validation.ts, typebox-helpers.ts, hash.ts
subtasks.context: Five shared utilities absent. Some are nice-to-have (diagnostics, validation); sanitize-unicode is load-bearing (prevents homograph attacks in CLI output).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each ported with unit tests.

subtasks.title: Image-models catalog (not just inline openrouter)
subtasks.context: Only one image provider is inline-wired; upstream has a catalog.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Image-models catalog generator; multiple image providers; smoke per provider.

subtasks.title: Compat overrides on ModelEntry (OpenAICompletionsCompat / OpenAIResponsesCompat / AnthropicMessagesCompat)
subtasks.context: ModelEntry has no per-model compat overrides upstream; pi-zig has none either, but consumers depend on it for openRouterRouting/vercelGatewayRouting.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: ModelEntry gains an optional compat struct; per-provider serializers read it; smoke per override.

subtasks.title: pi.* API: 14 missing methods
subtasks.context: Extension API surface is 8/22 wired. Missing: registerShortcut, registerMessageRenderer, registerProvider, unregisterProvider, setSessionName, getSessionName, setLabel, exec, getActiveTools, getAllTools, setActiveTools, getCommands, setModel, getThinkingLevel, setThinkingLevel.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each method wired in extension_runner.zig; pi.* shim exposes them; per-method smoke runs an extension calling the method and asserts the effect.

subtasks.title: Dispatch 17 currently-unfired lifecycle events
subtasks.context: Events context / before_agent_start / model_select / thinking_level_select / input / session_before_* / session_compact / session_shutdown / tool_execution_start/update/end / message_update / resources_discover are NEVER dispatched in production code.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each event has a dispatch site; per-event smoke asserts the extension handler observes it.

subtasks.title: Honor return values of 9 fire-and-forget lifecycle events
subtasks.context: session_start / before_provider_request / after_provider_response / agent_start/end / turn_start/end / message_start/end / user_bash fire but DISCARD return values. RuntimeLifecycleEmitContext.emit explicitly drops them (rpc.zig:3834-3842).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each event's return value is applied per upstream semantics (transform-chain or short-circuit); per-event smoke proves the effect.
requirements: Backwards-compat with extensions that return undefined

subtasks.title: Provider display names: 28-entry map
subtasks.context: pi-zig surfaces raw provider ids (google-vertex) instead of display names (Google Vertex AI).
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/provider_display.zig with the 28-entry map; commands/themes/RPC use it; smoke asserts UI shows display names.

subtasks.title: Models.json: ~/.pi/models.json loading + schema validation + applyModelOverride + mergeCompat + per-model headers
subtasks.context: Custom model registry: users put models in ~/.pi/models.json and pi-zig should load + validate + merge. None of this exists.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/custom_models.zig loads + validates + merges; openRouterRouting / vercelGatewayRouting helpers; per-model headers passed to ai_client; smoke uses a temp models.json.

subtasks.title: HTML export: marked.min.js + highlight.min.js vendored + ansi-to-html + ToolHtmlRenderer + 5-mode sidebar filter + branch-tree sidebar
subtasks.context: Server-side rendering works; the interactive SPA chrome is absent.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Vendor marked + highlight at build (in repo); ansi-to-html.zig converter; ToolHtmlRenderer interface; 5-mode filter UI; branch-tree sidebar with active-path markers; smoke loads the HTML in headless Chrome and asserts each element.

subtasks.title: Built-in tool *Operations seams + withFileMutationQueue + BashSpawnHook + image auto-resize + macOS read-path fallbacks + edit-tool diff/patch/firstChangedLine + prepareArguments legacy migration
subtasks.context: Tool execution is at parity; the customization seams + macOS fallbacks + ANSI-to-HTML + image worker are absent.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each seam implemented; macOS read-path variant fallback table ported; edit-tool result carries details.diff + patch + firstChangedLine; smoke proves each seam.

subtasks.title: keys.ts: Kitty + modifyOtherKeys + non-Latin-layout + Apple-Terminal + Windows-Terminal CSI-u (~900 LoC)
subtasks.context: pi-zig's tui_keys.zig handles legacy non-Kitty sequences; misses Kitty key protocol, modifyOtherKeys, non-Latin keyboard layouts, Apple Terminal CSI-u quirks, Windows Terminal CSI-u.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui_keys.zig fully ported; per-protocol unit tests; pty harness covers a Kitty terminal handshake.

subtasks.title: utils.ts: visible-width / ANSI-aware wrap / grapheme segmentation (~1100 LoC)
subtasks.context: pi-zig is byte-based throughout. Emoji, accented Latin, combining marks all break.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: src/pi/tui_text.zig with width / wrap / grapheme APIs based on Unicode UCD tables; unit tests for emoji + combining marks + accented Latin + ZWJ.

subtasks.title: terminal-image.ts + components/image.ts (~580 LoC)
subtasks.context: Zero image support. No kitty graphics, no iTerm2 inline images, no SIXEL.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui_image.zig with kitty + iTerm2 image protocols; smoke renders a tiny PNG and detects the escape.

subtasks.title: Components: input / settings-list / box / loader / cancellable-loader / text / spacer / truncated-text
subtasks.context: 8 small but load-bearing layout components entirely missing.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each component has a Zig module + unit tests; used by tui_messages and tui_footer.

subtasks.title: tui.ts: overlay compositor + IME CURSOR_MARKER + viewport + synchronized output + Kitty image lifecycle
subtasks.context: pi-zig's differential renderer doesn't composite overlays, has no IME cursor marker, no viewport math, no \x1b[?2026h/l synchronized output, no Kitty image lifecycle.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui.zig / tui_render.zig extended; each feature has a per-feature snapshot test.

subtasks.title: terminal.ts: bracketed paste / Kitty probe / drain / setTitle / setProgress / SIGWINCH / Windows console mode
subtasks.context: tui_terminal.zig has the basics; missing 7 specific behaviors.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each ported with smoke (where observable in stdout) or unit test.

subtasks.title: autocomplete.ts: @-path completion + fd-based fuzzy file walk
subtasks.context: No autocomplete in the composer. Upstream has @<partial-path> file fuzzy.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui_autocomplete.zig with fd-based walk + fuzzy match; integrated into editor; unit + smoke.

subtasks.title: stdin-buffer.ts: OSC/APC/DCS accumulator + bracketed-paste + 10ms partial-sequence flush + WezTerm escape fixup
subtasks.context: pi-zig reads stdin raw and parses each chunk synchronously. Long OSC/APC/DCS sequences can be split across reads and get mis-parsed.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: tui_stdin_buffer.zig accumulates partial sequences with a 10ms flush; bracketed-paste assembly; smoke pipes a split OSC sequence and asserts correct assembly.

subtasks.title: Editor: paste-marker system + visual-line nav + sticky preferred column + grapheme-aware cursor + jumpToChar + pageScroll + multi-level undo + autocomplete UI + bordered render
subtasks.context: tui_editor.zig has byte-based logic. Missing 9 specific editor features.
subtasks.definitionOfDone: Each feature added with unit tests + at least one pty smoke step.
